_note: The economy-model settings of the best case (Aisling). Every value must lie inside the slider's researched range in design/economy-params.json, on its favourable side of the central setting ('low' = at or below it, 'high' = at or above it, 'design' = a design target, anywhere in range). tests/aisling.mjs checks this, runs the model and fails if anything breaks or any account fails to close. The reasons for each value are in conditions.md.
